race.comment: IMMORTAL SPIRIT (2) is the one to beat off a sound recent platform, with a Halidon BM52 win two starts back and the key rider-horse record of two wins from five with Caitlyn Munro aboard. The quick back-up and 2kg claim both help him rebound from a plain sixth at Murray Bridge. GOOCHEE GAL (5) comes through Saturday company after finishing third at Morphettville at long odds, beaten a length and a half, and she is proven at this distance. Can give this a shake. TORRITA (8) has the strongest track-and-distance profile, with one win and two placings from three attempts at this track and distance, and her latest third here was full of merit. Include. THE ICE CUTTER (10) has to turn around a recent Halidon defeat by IMMORTAL SPIRIT, but weight relief, Brooke King returning and a solid record at this venue keep him firmly in the winning discussion.
